book.name: U-TESALLONAIKA
book.title: TESALLONAIKA Yomboma Pollone Wale Talo Pepá Topa Sirimu Bokutolo U-TESALLONAIKA Pollone TESALLONAIKA Yomboma Pepá U Topa Sirimu Bokumu

content: Pollone ‘Tesallonaika Karasinga Yomboma Konopu Tondolo Pupili Molangi.’ Nimba Timotindu “Pungu Ni-Pu.” Nimba Lipa Mundorumu Semanemo (2:17 pulu polko kanani)

Akumunga, ‘Ono nambi seko molemelenje.’ nimbu olio paa konopu awisili kimbu sipu ⸤ ‘Ungu se ningu mundungínje.’ nimbu⸥ nokopo molorumulu kinia ungu se naa ningu mundoringi-kulu siye serimumunga ‘⸤Saillas kinia⸥ olto ya kolea-awili Atenesi molambili.’ nimbu panjerimulu kinia

oltone Timoti “Ono molemelena pu.” nirimbulu. Timoti yu oltonga genu, pea kopu sepo Pulu Yemonga kongono sendepo Karasinga semane peangamo andopo topo silimulu yemo. “Yuni ono ‘enge ningu molko Karasi ‘Sika.’ ningu kuru mondolemele mele munduku naa kelko paa ambolko molangi.’ nipili.” nimbu yu ono molemelena lipu mundorumbulu.
Ono mindili nongo umbuna melemelemonga konopu kimbu siku molongenje.’ nimbu aku serimbulu. ‘Karasinga yomboma aku siku umbunama menge.’ nimba Pulu Yemone nilimú mele ono pilielemele.
Olio ono-kinia pea molopole ono liepi-liepi topo nimbuli: “Olio paa sika mindili singí, olio-kinia umbuna awisili wendo ombá.” nirimulu kanumu sika aku sipa wendo orumu mele ono kanolemele.

Akumunga, ‘Ono nambi seko molemelenje.’ nimbu konopu kimbu sirindu mele siye serimu-kulu ‘Konopu kimbu sikiru mele mania pupili.’ nimbu nane Timoti ono moloringina lipu mundorundu. ‘Ono kuru mondoko molemelenje molo kondi tolemo yemone ono kondi torumu kinia ononga kuru mondoringi mele we aku siku kuru mondolemele molo aku siku seko moloringi ulumu munduku kelieringinje. Kongono kála-sepo serimulumu we mania purumunje, piliambo.’ nimbu yu lipu mundorundu.
Timoti Kelepa Pollo Molorumuna Yando Omba Tesallonaika Yomboma Seko Moloringi Mele Semane Topa Sirimu Kinia Pilipale Pollo Yu Paa Konopu Sirimu Semanemo (2:17 pulu polko kanani)

Aku-sipa na-kolo kiniá mindi Timoti yando ombale ono ‘Sika’ ningu kuru mondoko yomboma konopu mondoko molemele mele semane peanga se omba topa simu. Alieli olio ono-kinia pea molorumulu mele onone konopu kimbu siku pilkuli paa konopu siku molemele mele nimba sipa, olione ‘Ono paa kanamiliya!’ nimbu molemolo mele ono aku sikula ‘Olio paa kanamiliya.’ ningu molemele mele nimba simu.
Akumunga, ango-keme, sika olio umbuna membo mindili nolemolo-na-kolo ono ‘Sika.’ ningu kuru mondoko molemele mele semanemo pilipuli konopu peanga pepili tondolo mundupu molemolo.
Ono Ye-Awilimu munduku naa kelko yu tondolo munduku ambolko molemelemonga pilipuli yombo konde pulimili mele kiniá paa manda molemolo.

Olio Pulu Yemo-kinia ungu nimbu molopo ono konopumuni pilipuli, ono seko molemelemonga paa awili sepo konopu sipu molemolo akumu nambi sepo Pulu Yemo-kinia manda “Ange.” nimulúye? Pulu Yemone aku sipa olio ‘konopu siemili.’ nilimúmunga yunga kumbikerena pumbu konopu lakopo sipu molemolomonga olione alieli yu-kinia “Ange.” nimulú manda naa sembá.
Pollone Tesallonaika Karasinga Yombomanga Pulu Yemo Mawa Senderimu Ungu Se

Ipulieli kepe tangoli kepe Pulu Yemo-kinia ungu nimbuli ‘Olio ono ombo kanamili. Aulka se akisindepili.’ nimbu paa tondolo mundupu mawa selemolo. ‘Ononga kuru mondolemele mele kamu kuru mondonge ungu se pilku naa molongi liemu aku mólo tolemo unguma ombo nimbu siemili.’ nimbu aku sipu mawa selemolo.
Kiniá Pulu Ye olionga Lapa akumu kinia olionga Ye-Awili Yesusi kinia olone olio ono molemelena ‘Wamili.’ ningu aulka se akisindengili.
Pulu Yemone Kanopa Peanga Pilielemo Ulumanga Ungu Se
Olione ono konopu paa awili sepo mondolemolo mele Ye-Awilimuni ‘Onone aku siku ononga Karasinga yomboma kinia we-yomboma kinia pali konopu paa olandopa olandopa mondangi.’ nipili.

Olionga Ye-Awili Yesusi yunga yombo kake selima kinia kelepa ombá walemonga ono Pulu Ye olionga Lapamo molombana pungu molonge kinia konopu kake sepa Pulu Yemone kanopa kiri pilipa kote sendemba ulu-pulu se konopuna naa pepili molonge kinia ‘yuni kanopili.’ nimba Ye-Awilimuni ononga konopuma tondolo mundundopili.
